Sleek Living – Two Bedroom Private Pool Villa in Pererenan

2
3
Land: 1.2 Are
Building: 100m2

Description

This modern and stylish villa is located in a prime area of Pererenan, offering easy access to cafes, restaurants, wellness spots, and the beach. With a convenient location and a sleek design, it is ideal for both comfortable living and rental opportunities.

Set on 120 sqm of land, the villa comes fully furnished and features two bedrooms and three bathrooms. The semi-open living area creates a bright and relaxed atmosphere, with direct access to the private swimming pool.

The villa comes with standard furnishings and a practical layout, making it easy to move in and enjoy or prepare for a subleasing business.

Several restaurants and cafes are within walking distance, while popular destinations around Pererenan and Canggu are just a short motorbike ride away.

Nearby:

1 minute to Wellness Gym Canggu

2 minutes to Elite Fit Bali & BODY CRAFT ELEMENTS BALI

3 minutes to Jalan Raya Padang Linjong & Jalan Raya Batu Mejan via shortcut

3 minutes to Brunch Club Pererenan

4 minutes to Pepito Market Eco Beach & MIEL SPECIALTY COFFEE CANGGU | CO-WORKING

7 minutes to Pererenan Beach

A stylish and practical villa offering modern living, a private pool, and an excellent location in the heart of Pererenan.
